description: Review a described animation against the twelve animation principles (squash and stretch, anticipation, staging, pose to pose, follow through, slow in and slow out, arcs, secondary action, timing, exaggeration, solid drawing, appeal). Pass `description` (what moves, how, how long, why) and optionally `purpose` (ui, marketing, illustration). Keyword-based: a principle marked 'not mentioned' may still be present in the design, and one marked 'mentioned' is not proof it is done well. Each principle comes with a question to answer and how it translates to interface motion. Also flags stated durations over 400 ms for UI.

description.description: Describe the animation: what moves, easing, timing, purpose

name: review_animation_principles
title: Animation principles review
